title: Verify installed-process operator throughput bounds
preconditions: A linux-x64 Native-AOT publish and isolated 146-row plus 10000-row evaluations are available with process-count and peak-memory measurement.
steps: Use only the published CLI to retrieve the 146-row result with pageSize 500 and to walk maximum-size filtered results at page sizes 1 and 500; record process launches, continuations, wall time, memory, row accounting, and child processes.
expected: The 146-row case uses one classify.outcome.list process; general walks use exactly ceiling(filteredCount/pageSize) processes; each call is within 5 seconds and 256 MiB; no per-row CLI or Ledger subprocess occurs; one-over limits fail with no partial result or mutation.
cleanup: Remove the temporary publish and isolated data root.
